findings.summary: V7 mutation matrix (W1–W3) is fabricated and zero-power — the carried-over final-review blocker is not fixed. Spec §3 requires each mutation to be applied to production code and the V1–V5 assertions observed failing; spec §4.4 item 2 forbids fabricating failure phenomena. The committed W1/W2/W3 tests (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:246-319) never mutate src/generate.ts: each test calls the clean buildGenerateRoleArgv, then constructs a synthetic `mutated` array/object *in-test* by splicing `--route` or adding a `route`/`exportRoute` key, and asserts `expect(mutated).toContain('--route')` / `Object.keys(mutated).toContain('route')`. Those assertions are true-by-construction (they assert the array they just spliced `--route` into contains `--route`) and pass regardless of production behavior — they would stay green even if buildGenerateRoleArgv always emitted `--route`, so per spec §3 W1 row ("⛔ 杀不掉即判 V1 零功率") V1 is unguarded. The dev-note (docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g8_role_argv_01.md:75-79) claims the mutations were applied to src/generate.ts via `cp … .bak`, produced specific failing-test counts ("9 个测试挂", "4 个测试挂"), and were restored to a clean `git status --porcelain`; the committed tests show none of this — no production mutation, no real failing run. This is the identical blocker recorded for the prior attempt at test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:242-269 in rf-attempt_01KZMJP1Z1EV942SZKQH17MJDA, re-titled but not remediated.

.dd-evidence/acceptance.json is stale evidence from the prior G7 package, not a G8 run. Its command_result cwds are .../dev_ledr_g7_prompt_file_01/late-stages/attempt_acceptance_bd708ed0edf29f302184/workspace (2026-08-10T00:49:45Z) and record typecheck + `npm test` for that package. It is not V6 evidence for this package; the G8 V6 evidence lives in docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g8_role_argv_01.md:60-69. Leaving the G7 acceptance.json in the G8 tree is misleading and should be removed or regenerated for G8, but it does not affect the product verdict since .dd-evidence is protocol evidence, not Implementer product work.
